_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Nang masha {player_id} hpe LinesOfAction shangai gawng kasa hta na matu.
Nang hte masha '{side}' hpe, hpang jahtu masha '{other}' hpe.
Lam hku hte seng ai hku na matu: `[b1b3]` (hku hte seng ai hku na matu). Lam hku hte seng ai hku na matu hta kaw nna, masha hte maren sha ai lam hku hte seng ai lam hpe yu ai hku na matu. Nang masha hte maren sha ai lam hku hte seng ai lam hpe yu ai hku na matu, hpang jahtu masha hpe n yu ai; hpang jahtu masha hpe yu ai hku na matu hta kaw nna, nang masha hpe jaw ai.  Nang masha hte maren sha ai lam hku hte seng ai lam hpe 8-hku na matu hta kaw nna, jaw ai.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format gaw e2e4 (from,to coordinates) rai ra ai.
invalid_move.no_piece: No {side} piece on {coord}. N dai gaw, n pu na laika man kaw lawm ai rai nga ai.
invalid_move.identical: Npawt hte sa ai shara gaw bung nga ai.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Shamu shamawt ai lam gaw dingyang (sh) diagonal hku nna galaw ra ai.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Dai gaw, sumri langai hte sha maren tsan ai shara de sa wa ra ai.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Hpyen ni a palawng gaw lam hpe pat kau ai.

game_action.captured_suffix: Masha {player_id} hpe {from} -> {to} hku hte seng ai lam, hpang jahtu masha hpe jaw ai.

outcome.win: Yawng gaw matut mahkai nga ai.
outcome.draw_no_capture: Hkum rim la lu ai lam n nga hkra, lahkam 60 hkawm sai.
outcome.draw_repetition: Hkring shara hpe masum lang bai tsun ai.
